root_cause: The _onBeforeShow() method in drawer.ts hardcodes the test page's specific ID '#filters-close' when focusing the close button. Component code must work generically on any page using the drawer, not reference page-specific IDs.
repair_strategy: Replace the hardcoded ID selector with a generic selector that finds the drawer's dismiss button using the standard Bootstrap data attribute pattern [data-bs-dismiss="drawer"]. This works on any page because the dismiss button is marked with this attribute in the component's markup contract.
expected_accessibility_effect: Upon opening any drawer, focus will be placed on the drawer's close button (identified by data-bs-dismiss="drawer"), allowing keyboard users to immediately press Tab to navigate into the drawer's content and interact with form controls.
functional_risks: If a drawer lacks a dismiss button with data-bs-dismiss="drawer", the focus attempt is safely skipped due to the null check.
The focus change occurs after swipe initialization, preserving existing touch/swipe behavior.
verification_requirements: After activating the filters button with Enter, the active element must be the drawer's close button (data-bs-dismiss="drawer").
Subsequent Tab presses must move focus to the first focusable element in the drawer (e.g., #in-stock checkbox), then through other controls.
Pressing Space on a checkbox must toggle its checked state.
Pressing Enter on the 'Show results' button must update the applied filter output and close the drawer.
Pressing Escape must close the drawer and return focus to the trigger button.
